description:
Roselyn, who was exiled due to a minor(?) incident involving her witch clan, opens a public bathhouse called the 'Men's Bathhouse' in the capital of the empire. While she was busy managing the business, dreaming of killing two birds with one stone by using her specialty of potion making while seeing handsome men, one day, the magician Michael Winterman, who was suspicious of the bath's efficacy, comes to visit. Roselyn ends up spending a night with Michael due to an accident. After that, she meets Michael repeatedly, who keeps coming to her, and Jibril comes to find her in the desert. Michael and Jibril meet at the men's bathhouse! For some reason, the two men seem to be engaged in a war of nerves over Roselyn... ?

(Source: Naver Series, translated)
